scope: Catalog organization only; no changes to gameplay or existing map selection
assignment_rule: Exactly one primary district per ID; original course eligibility is many-to-many and never inferred from appearance

districts.label: Commercial high street
districts.placement_guidance: Continuous shopfronts, awnings and signs; group related storefronts along the same block.

districts.label: Office centre
districts.placement_guidance: Taller urban business blocks; concentrate rather than scatter among farms.

districts.label: Chinatown
districts.placement_guidance: Chinese-influenced fronts with the gateway as a landmark; City-family association observed.

districts.label: Victorian residential
districts.placement_guidance: Residential rows with bays and stoops; keep neighbouring heights and roof language coherent.

districts.label: Small-town main street
districts.placement_guidance: Lower town-centre frontages; use in rural/coastal towns rather than treating all as downtown offices.

districts.label: Run-down quarter
districts.placement_guidance: Boarded and worn urban streets; transition from industrial or older residential blocks.

districts.label: Industrial / warehouses
districts.placement_guidance: Loading bays, large gridded windows and service yards; reserve access outside the race carriageway.

districts.label: Farms / agriculture
districts.placement_guidance: Barns, grain storage and open hay shelters; standalone field-edge placement with yard clearance.

districts.label: Rural village / winery
districts.placement_guidance: Detached homes, community landmarks and winery; space these as settlements, not touching urban facades.

districts.label: Roadside services
districts.placement_guidance: Shared settlement services; use course eligibility and site clearance, not every service in every district.

districts.label: Utilities / service yards
districts.placement_guidance: Ancillary tanks and facilities; site behind/alongside compatible buildings, not as frontage substitutes.

districts.label: Retaining walls / tunnels
districts.placement_guidance: Structural wall, tunnel and tower kit; follows terrain/engineering needs, never random building lots.

districts.label: Shared roof / edge modules
districts.placement_guidance: Reusable trim modules; select for architectural compatibility and dimensions, not standalone building placement.
